name: sentinel
description: SENTINEL — Real-Time Decision Intelligence Platform (Microsoft Innovate 2026 PS34)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sentinel/api" "npm run dev -w @sentinel/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentinel/shared && npm run build -w @sentinel/api && npm run build -w @sentinel/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sentinel/shared && npm run test -w @sentinel/api && npm run test -w @sentinel/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sentinel/shared && npm run build -w @sentinel/api && npm run typecheck -w @sentinel/web
